sources.title: GitHub - 0xShug0/audio.cpp: An all-in-one, pure C++ inference engine ...
sources.snippet: audio.cpp is built for real end-to-end execution rather than one-off model demos. Its optimized, reusable building blocks support speech generation and recognition, separation, alignment, and multi-model workflows. Shared components make new models easier to integrate and let improvements benefit multiple model families while keeping inference efficient, maintainable, and portable.
